'''Kim Sun-kee''' ({{Korean|hangul=김선기|hanja=金善基}};<ref>{{Cite web |title='이달의 과학기술자상' 서울대 김선기 교수 |url=https://www.sciencetimes.co.kr/nscvrg/view/menu/262?searchCategory=231&nscvrgSn=55960 |access-date=2025-08-11 |website=www.sciencetimes.co.kr |language=ko}}</ref> born May 20, 1960) is a South Korean physicist. He is professor in [[Seoul National University]] and director of the [[Korea Invisible Mass Search]].<ref name="ChoiKim2005">{{cite book|author1=Kiwoon Choi |author-link1= Choi Kiwoon
 |author2=Jihn E. Kim|author3=Dongchul Son|title=Particles, Strings and Cosmology: 11th International Symposium on Particles, Strings and Cosmology; PASCOS 2005|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=pdiTnydMx04C&pg=PA75|date=12 December 2005|publisher=Springer|isbn=978-0-7354-0295-9|pages=75–81}}</ref> He was the first director of the [[RAON|Rare Isotope Science Project]] within the [[Institute for Basic Science]]<ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.sisajournal.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=176699 |script-title=ko:1조4000억 투입 중이온가속기 구축사업단장 또 중도 사임 |last= 김 |first= 상현 |date= 31 July 2018 |website=[[Sisa Journal]] |publisher= Sisa Press |access-date= 28 January 2019 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> and is a member of the [[Korean Academy of Science and Technology]].<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.kast.or.kr/kr/member/member_view.php?idx=4914 |script-title=ko:한국과학기술한림원 - 회원 - 회원소개 |author=<!--Not stated--> |date= |website= [[Korean Academy of Science and Technology]] |publisher= |access-date= 28 January 2019 |quote= |language= Korean }}</ref>

==Education==
* 1979−1983: BS, [[Korea University]]
* 1983−1985: MS, Korea University
* 1985−1988: Ph.D. Korea University

==Work==
[[File:Three Kims of the Korea Invisible Mass Search (KIMS).jpg|thumb|The three founders of [[Korea Invisible Mass Search]]; left to right Kim Sun-kee, Kim Hongjoo, and {{ill|Kim Yeongduk|ko|김영덕 (물리학자)}}.]]
Positions held
*1988−1990: Research Associate, [[KEK]], Japan
*1990−1992: Senior Research Associate, [[Rutgers University]]
*1992−1996: Assistant Professor, Seoul National University
*1996−2002: Associate Professor, Seoul National University
*2002−present: Professor, Seoul National University
*2011−present: Director, Rare Isotope Science Project, Institute for Basic Science
*1995−1995: Visiting Scientist, [[Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory]]
*1999−1999: Visiting Scientist, KEK

Major research activities
*1985−1996: AMY experiment, TRISTAN, KEK  e+e- collider experiment
*1990−1992: E799, Rare Kaon decay experiment, Fermilab
*1994−1998: D0 experiment, [[Tevatron|TEVATRON]], Fermilab
*1994−2011: BELLE experiment, KEKB, KEK
*1996−2000: ATIC, balloon borne experiment, NASA
*2000−2011: [[Korea Invisible Mass Search]] (spokesperson), South Korea
  
Professional service activities
*1992−1994: Korea SSC committee
*1994−2001: Executive board, [[Belle experiment|Belle Collaboration]]
*1996−1998: Investigators Consultative Group between Korea-NASA 
*1998−2001: Organizing committee, World Wide Study on Physics and Detector at LC
*2000−2006: Director of Dark Matter Research Center 
*2001−2002: Advisory committee, [[Proton therapy|Proton Therapy]] Center at National Cancer Center
*2005−2009: Chair, Association of Korean High Energy Physicists
*2006−2012: Committee for the Promotion of Korea-CERN Collaboration, MEST
*2008−present: International Detector Advisory Group of ILC
*2009−2010: Chair, [[Particle physics|Particle Physics]] Division, [[Korean Physical Society]]
*2011−2011: Steering Committee for Heavy Ion Accelerator, MEST
*2012−2014: National Committee for Fusion Research, MEST 
*2012−2014: R&D Policy Advisory Committee, National Fusion Research Institute

==Awards==
*1991: SSC Fellow, TNRLC
*2006: [[Koshiba Prize]], Foundation for High Energy Accelerator Science, Japan<ref>{{cite web |url= https://n.news.naver.com/mnews/article/081/0000076188?sid=104 |title= 日 '고시바상' 외국인 첫 수상 |author= 유지혜 |date= 1 February 2006 |website= [[Naver]] |publisher=[[Seoul Shinmun]] |access-date= 10 March 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>
*2008: [[Scientist of the Month]], [[Ministry of Education, Science and Technology (South Korea)|Ministry of Education, Science and Technology of South Korea]]<ref>{{cite web |url= https://news.naver.com/main/read.nhn?mode=LSD&mid=sec&sid1=101&oid=003&aid=0001959408 |title= '이달의 과학기술자상' 2월 수상자에 서울대 김선기 교수 |last= 김 |first= 훈기 |date= |website=[[Naver News]] |publisher=[[Newsis]] |access-date= 28 January 2019 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.fnnews.com/news/200802131823348484 |script-title=ko:이달의 과학기술자賞 김선기 교수 |last= 이 |first= 재원 |date= 13 February 2008 |website=[[The Financial News]]|publisher= |access-date= 28 January 2019 |language= Korean}}</ref>
*2008: SNU Award for Excellent Research
